title: prompt_agent, answer_agent and wait_agent result
description: What prompt_agent, answer_agent and wait_agent hand back to the model (docs/agent-tools.md, section 2). Either one call's result (`call_id` and `state`, with what that state carries), or a refusal (`error` alone: nothing was sent and no call changed), or wait_agent's timeout (`state` running and `call_ids`). Returned files are saved on the caller's machine; the result carries their paths, never their bytes. An extension may add fields to a call's result (docs/agent-tools.md, section 6.3).

oneOf.title: wait_agent: no call ready in time

call_id.description: the call: the argument wait_agent, answer_agent and cancel_agent take; opaque, valid until the call is dropped from the list

state.description: running: the agent works on it. input_required: it asked a question (answer_agent). completed: its reply is here. failed: no reply came (error). cancelled: cancel_agent stopped it, or the served prompt it belonged to ended. expired: it ran past its runtime limit

label.description: the label prompt_agent was given, when it was given one; never sent to the target

reply.description: completed: the prompted agent's reply, every streamed chunk joined in order

question.description: input_required: the question the prompted agent asks mid-stream (protocol §7); the stream stays open until answer_agent answers it

error.description: failed or expired: why no reply came, in words (an unknown address, a refused prompt, a stalled stream, the runtime limit). Without call_id: why the tool did nothing (a bad argument, an unknown call_id, a loop, the limit on tracked calls)

partial_reply.description: failed, cancelled or expired: the reply text received before the call ended; absent when there was none

attachments.description: the files the prompted agent sent: with a question, those that came with it; otherwise those that came with the reply (all of them once the call finished). Saved on this machine by the SDK's saveAttachments / save_attachments; their bytes never reach the model

filename.description: the name as the sender gave it

size_bytes.description: the decoded size; 0 when the content was not valid base64

path.description: the absolute path of the saved file on this machine; null when it was not saved

skipped.description: why the file was not saved: past the limit per call, or content that is not valid base64

remaining.description: wait_agent, with a call's result: the other given calls that are still open (running or input_required)

call_ids.description: wait_agent's timeout: the given calls, all still running

open_calls.description: how many calls in the current scope are still open (running or input_required), this one included; absent when none is

open_calls_note.description: the same, in words, with what happens to them
